title: Checksum error on US 14 day sensors
symptom: US 14 day sensors no longer work with xDrip. When scanning directly with NFC the error is: 'Read data but checksum is wrong.' When connected via the MiaoMiao: 'We have all the data we need 363 checksum_ok = false'.
cause: The thread suspects encryption different from international sensors, but no definitive cause is established.
fix: A solution for 14 days US sensors exists via a Medium article by miaomiaoreader, but the thread does not provide specific steps.
evidence_quote: A solution for 14 days us sensors exists here: https://medium.com/@miaomiaoreader/how-to-make-libre-us-14-days-sensors-work-with-miaomiao2-on-xdrip-35b431a40940
